Date: 2027-04-22T08:15:00Z
Subject: Request: Region proof pack + VPC peering matrix for EU-only hosting

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Medicapture's security team had a couple of follow-ups before we proceed to procurement. For our internal legal and cloud-architecture review we need a short "region proof pack" that documents the following for EU-only hosting:

- Confirmation that customer data for our tenant will be pinned to EU regions (which regions specifically).
- VPC/private deployment topology options and any peering or private-link configuration we must follow.
- KMS/HSM partitioning: whether tenant keys are region-scoped and what KMS providers are used.
- A simple VPC peering matrix that lists endpoints, required ports, and any dedicated peering steps.

We're trying to keep things tight — a one-page attestation + an Excel peering matrix should do. Also, please include any SOC 2 / CAIQ references that map to the controls we care about (data locality, network segregation, key management).

Can you share by EOD Friday if possible?

Regards,
Elena
Elena Voss
Head of Cloud Security, Medicapture

Elena — thanks for the clear ask.

Karthik / Marissa: can you assemble a minimal proof pack (prefer one-page attestation) and a peering matrix that covers: EU regions we offer (eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-central-1), private endpoint options (VPC peering, PrivateLink), and KMS partitioning notes (customer keys in EU by default; HSM-backed where requested). Include references to SOC 2 sections and CAIQ questions that map to data locality and cryptographic controls.

Specifics Medicapture requested: EU-only (no cross-border egress), peering matrix with ports and directionality, and the KMS/HSM isolation statement. If we have a short template attestation we can reuse, great — otherwise draft one and I'll review before sending to Elena.

Deadline: EOD Friday (2027-04-23) — if you need one extra business day, flag now.

Irene Choi

Irene / Marissa — starting a draft. Summary of what I'll include:

1) One-page attestation draft (text) confirming EU-only residency for tenant LockedTenant-789, with note that the control plane metadata (non-customer content telemetry) is processed in the control plane region but can be configured to EU-only for dedicated/private deployments.

2) VPC peering matrix (spreadsheet): rows for endpoint name, region, required ports (e.g., 443, 2200 for management), direction (initiator/acceptor), recommended MTU and expected CIDR examples.

3) KMS/HSM: summary CSV showing key partitions per region, provider (AWS KMS with multi-AZ EU keys / optional HSM modules for Dedicated), and operational owner contacts.

4) Mapping notes: SOC 2 CC6/CC7 (logical and physical access), CAIQ network + cryptography mappings, and pointers to our SOC 2 report excerpted sections.

I uploaded initial drafts to a shared drive link and attached the current spreadsheets for internal review.

Attachments (internal drafts): region_proofpack_draft.txt (draft attestation), vpc_peering_matrix_v2.xlsx (workbook), kms_key_partition_summary.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_proofpack

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena.voss@medicapture.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T14:05:00Z
Subject: Final: Region proof pack + VPC peering matrix (EU-only)

Elena — thanks for the patience. Per Irene's note, we've consolidated the requested items into a short proof pack and a peering matrix. Highlights below; full files attached and the drive link is provided.

Summary highlights:
- Residency: For private/dedicated and VPC-hosted options, customer data (request/response and derived artifacts) are stored only in EU regions by configuration. Default EU regions available: eu-west-1 (Ireland), eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), eu-west-2 (London).
- Control plane: Control plane metadata can be restricted to EU regions for Private deployments. For hosted multi-tenant customers, certain anonymized telemetry may be stored in our control plane region; see attestation text for gallery of options.
- VPC connectivity: We support both VPC peering and provider PrivateLink. See vpc_peering_matrix_v2.xlsx for per-endpoint port list, initiator/acceptor guidance, and stepwise peering checklist. Management plane (SSH/maintenance) is segregated and only opened via ephemeral jump hosts or customer-requested dedicated management link.
- KMS/HSM: Keys are region-scoped by default. For Dedicated contracts we can provide HSM-backed key partitions; see kms_key_partition_summary.csv for current partitioning and key-owner contacts.
- Compliance mapping: We included quick pointers to SOC 2 sections relevant to network segregation and crypto; CAIQ questions mapped in the proof pack appendix.

Next steps / asks for Medicapture:
1) Confirm which EU region you prefer for production pinning.
2) Accept the peering checklist or request a working session with our infra engineer (Jonas) to walk through firewall and routing specifics.
3) If you require HSM-backed tenancy, indicate in writing so we can provision vendor quotes.

Attachments: region_proofpack_v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page attestation + appendix), vpc_peering_matrix_v2.xlsx (Excel workbook), kms_key_partition_summary.csv (CSV)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_proofpack

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Technical Solutions
Redwood Inference
